list.name: check
list.label: Check
list.query: All : all, Ready · dep. not declared : ready_undeclared, Ready · may be claimed : ready_claimable, In progress > 1 day : in_progress_long, In review > 1 day : in_review_long, Refinement · not reviewed : refinement_unreviewed, Board Done · issue open : done_open

query.query: query_result(label_replace(((epic_ticket_info and on(issue) (epic_ticket_check_member and on(check) label_replace(vector(1), "check", "$check", "", ""))) or (epic_ticket_info and on() (label_replace(vector(1), "check", "$check", "", "") and on(check) label_replace(vector(1), "check", "all", "", "")))) and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1), "pr_url", "https://github.com/phaabe/live.moafunk.de/pull/$1", "pr", "(.+)"))

panels.title: Ready · dep. not declared
panels.description: Ready, and an open blocked-by issue is not named in a Start after line of a readiness comment. The runner could claim it too early. Color: amber or red when a ticket waits too long. Click to show these tickets in the table.

targets.expr: ((epic_ticket_check_count{check="ready_undeclared"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)) or on() vector(-1))

(label_replace((epic_ticket_check_severity{check="ready_undeclared"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)) == 3, "color", "#C8342E", "", "")) or (label_replace((epic_ticket_check_severity{check="ready_undeclared"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)) == 2, "color", "#E0A526", "", "")) or (label_replace((epic_ticket_check_severity{check="ready_undeclared"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)) == 1, "color", "text", "", "")) or (label_replace((epic_ticket_check_severity{check="ready_undeclared"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)) == 0, "color", "text", "", ""))

panels.title: Ready · may be claimed
panels.description: Ready, and the runner selector would offer it as a claim now. Color: amber or red when a ticket waits too long. Click to show these tickets in the table.

targets.expr: ((epic_ticket_check_count{check="ready_claimable"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)) or on() vector(-1))

(label_replace((epic_ticket_check_severity{check="ready_claimable"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)) == 3, "color", "#C8342E", "", "")) or (label_replace((epic_ticket_check_severity{check="ready_claimable"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)) == 2, "color", "#E0A526", "", "")) or (label_replace((epic_ticket_check_severity{check="ready_claimable"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)) == 1, "color", "text", "", "")) or (label_replace((epic_ticket_check_severity{check="ready_claimable"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)) == 0, "color", "text", "", ""))

targets.expr: ((epic_ticket_check_count{check="in_progress_long"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)) or on() vector(-1))

(label_replace((epic_ticket_check_severity{check="in_progress_long"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)) == 3, "color", "#C8342E", "", "")) or (label_replace((epic_ticket_check_severity{check="in_progress_long"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)) == 2, "color", "#E0A526", "", "")) or (label_replace((epic_ticket_check_severity{check="in_progress_long"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)) == 1, "color", "text", "", "")) or (label_replace((epic_ticket_check_severity{check="in_progress_long"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)) == 0, "color", "text", "", ""))

panels.title: In review > 1 day
panels.description: In review for more than 24 h (since the collector saw it enter; at least that long for tickets it found there). Color: amber or red when a ticket waits too long. Click to show these tickets in the table.

targets.expr: ((epic_ticket_check_count{check="in_review_long"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)) or on() vector(-1))

(label_replace((epic_ticket_check_severity{check="in_review_long"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)) == 3, "color", "#C8342E", "", "")) or (label_replace((epic_ticket_check_severity{check="in_review_long"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)) == 2, "color", "#E0A526", "", "")) or (label_replace((epic_ticket_check_severity{check="in_review_long"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)) == 1, "color", "text", "", "")) or (label_replace((epic_ticket_check_severity{check="in_review_long"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)) == 0, "color", "text", "", ""))

(label_replace((epic_ticket_check_severity{check="refinement_unreviewed"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)) == 3, "color", "#C8342E", "", "")) or (label_replace((epic_ticket_check_severity{check="refinement_unreviewed"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)) == 2, "color", "#E0A526", "", "")) or (label_replace((epic_ticket_check_severity{check="refinement_unreviewed"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)) == 1, "color", "text", "", "")) or (label_replace((epic_ticket_check_severity{check="refinement_unreviewed"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)) == 0, "color", "text", "", ""))

panels.title: Board Done · issue open
panels.description: Board Status is Done but the issue is still open. Color: amber or red when a ticket waits too long. Click to show these tickets in the table.

targets.expr: ((epic_ticket_check_count{check="done_open"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)) or on() vector(-1))

(label_replace((epic_ticket_check_severity{check="done_open"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)) == 3, "color", "#C8342E", "", "")) or (label_replace((epic_ticket_check_severity{check="done_open"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)) == 2, "color", "#E0A526", "", "")) or (label_replace((epic_ticket_check_severity{check="done_open"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)) == 1, "color", "text", "", "")) or (label_replace((epic_ticket_check_severity{check="done_open"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)) == 0, "color", "text", "", ""))

panels.title: Backlog
panels.description: Tickets in Backlog now; the change is against 7 days ago. Unknown while the board was not read in the last 5 min.

targets.expr: epic_tickets_by_status{status="Backlog"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1) and on() (last_over_time((time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds)[1m:] @ end()) < 300) and on() ((epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} @ end()) == 1) and on() (epic_tickets_by_status{status="Backlog"} @ end())

panels.title: Refinement
panels.description: Tickets in Refinement now; the change is against 7 days ago. Unknown while the board was not read in the last 5 min.

targets.expr: epic_tickets_by_status{status="Refinement"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1) and on() (last_over_time((time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds)[1m:] @ end()) < 300) and on() ((epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} @ end()) == 1) and on() (epic_tickets_by_status{status="Refinement"} @ end())

panels.title: Ready
panels.description: Tickets in Ready now; the change is against 7 days ago. Unknown while the board was not read in the last 5 min.

targets.expr: epic_tickets_by_status{status="Ready"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1) and on() (last_over_time((time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds)[1m:] @ end()) < 300) and on() ((epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} @ end()) == 1) and on() (epic_tickets_by_status{status="Ready"} @ end())

targets.expr: epic_tickets_by_status{status="In progress"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1) and on() (last_over_time((time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds)[1m:] @ end()) < 300) and on() ((epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} @ end()) == 1) and on() (epic_tickets_by_status{status="In progress"} @ end())

targets.expr: epic_tickets_by_status{status="Done"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1) and on() (last_over_time((time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds)[1m:] @ end()) < 300) and on() ((epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} @ end()) == 1) and on() (epic_tickets_by_status{status="Done"} @ end())

panels.title: Tickets per status
panels.description: Task and Subtask tickets per board status. Gaps: the collector did not see the board then.

targets.expr: sum by (status) (epic_tickets_by_status) and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)

panels.title: Tickets · $check
panels.description: Choose a check with a tile or the Check picker; All shows every ticket: not Done, plus Done in the last 7 days or still open. In status: since the collector saw the ticket enter its status; ≥ is a lower bound (found there, or the entry is unsure), ? crosses a gap in the collector's data. Since Ready: the last entry into Ready. (unverified): the agent comes from a run event, not from GitHub.

targets.expr: label_replace(((epic_ticket_info and on(issue) (epic_ticket_check_member and on(check) label_replace(vector(1), "check", "$check", "", ""))) or (epic_ticket_info and on() (label_replace(vector(1), "check", "$check", "", "") and on(check) label_replace(vector(1), "check", "all", "", "")))) and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1), "pr_url", "https://github.com/phaabe/live.moafunk.de/pull/$1", "pr", "(.+)")

(time() - epic_ticket_status_entered_seconds and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)) and on(issue) label_replace(((epic_ticket_info and on(issue) (epic_ticket_check_member and on(check) label_replace(vector(1), "check", "$check", "", ""))) or (epic_ticket_info and on() (label_replace(vector(1), "check", "$check", "", "") and on(check) label_replace(vector(1), "check", "all", "", "")))) and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1), "pr_url", "https://github.com/phaabe/live.moafunk.de/pull/$1", "pr", "(.+)")

(max by (issue) (epic_ticket_status_entered_seconds) * 1000 and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)) and on(issue) label_replace(((epic_ticket_info and on(issue) (epic_ticket_check_member and on(check) label_replace(vector(1), "check", "$check", "", ""))) or (epic_ticket_info and on() (label_replace(vector(1), "check", "$check", "", "") and on(check) label_replace(vector(1), "check", "all", "", "")))) and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1), "pr_url", "https://github.com/phaabe/live.moafunk.de/pull/$1", "pr", "(.+)")

panels.title: Status history · $check
panels.description: One row per ticket over 7 days, in the order the rows start. In progress and In review show the agent. Empty parts: the collector did not see the board then. A check filter keeps the full history of its tickets.

targets.expr: topk by (segment_id) (1, max_over_time({stream="ticket_segments"} | json | issue=~"$issues" | keep segment_id, issue, status, agent, start, rev | label_format text="{{.status}}{{if .agent}} · {{.agent}}{{end}}", start_ms="{{.start}}000" | unwrap rev [7d]) by (segment_id, issue, text, start_ms))
epic_ticket_info{status="Backlog"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)
epic_ticket_info{status="Refinement"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)
epic_ticket_info{status="Ready"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)
epic_ticket_info{status="In progress"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)
epic_ticket_info{status="In review"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)

panels.title: Done
panels.description: Done: still-open issues first, then the newest closed.

targets.expr: epic_ticket_info{status="Done"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)

panels.title: Aging · 20 longest in status
panels.description: Open tickets (not Done) by time in their current status. ≥ is a lower bound, ? crosses a gap in the collector's data.

targets.expr: topk(20, (time() - epic_ticket_status_entered_seconds) * on(issue) group_left(title, status, url) epic_ticket_info{status!="Done"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1))

panels.title: Done per day · by executor
panels.description: Tickets that entered Done per day (Berlin time), last 14 days, by the Executor at that time.

targets.expr: epic_tickets_done_day and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)

panels.title: Cycle time
panels.description: First In progress to Done, tickets done in the last 14 days.

targets.expr: epic_ticket_cycle_quantile_seconds{quantile="0.5"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)
epic_ticket_cycle_quantile_seconds{quantile="0.85"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)

panels.title: Lead time · median
panels.description: First Ready to Done, tickets done in the last 14 days.

targets.expr: epic_ticket_lead_median_seconds and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)

panels.title: Time in status · p50 and p85
panels.description: Summed time in each status per done ticket, last 14 days. A status without clean samples has no bar.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(epic_ticket_time_in_status_seconds{quantile="0.5"}, "order", "0", "status", "Refinement"), "order", "1", "status", "Ready"), "order", "2", "status", "In progress"), "order", "3", "status", "In review") and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)
epic_ticket_time_in_status_seconds{quantile="0.85"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)

panels.title: Done tickets · cycle and lead time
panels.description: Tickets that entered Done in the last 14 days, newest first. Cycle: first In progress to Done. Lead: first Ready to Done. –: not measured (the ticket skipped the status, or the time crosses a gap in the collector's data).

targets.expr: label_join(epic_ticket_done_seconds * 1000, "key", "/", "issue", "episode") and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)

sum by (key) (label_join(epic_ticket_cycle_seconds, "key", "/", "issue", "episode")) and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)

sum by (key) (label_join(epic_ticket_lead_seconds, "key", "/", "issue", "episode")) and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)
